## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      1 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 3 авг. 2026 г. - 3 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Anthony Taylor_, 3 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "I chose Habitify and prepaid for a full year of Premium because it showed an overall daily completion score across my habits and categories. After the update, weekly and monthly habits no longer count, so my score shows 0%. Support confirmed this is intentional. Removing the main feature customers paid for during an active annual subscription is ridiculous and deeply disappointing. Unless it is restored, I will cancel and switch apps."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      2 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 10 мар. 2026 г. - 15 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Tom_, 15 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "bought a lifetime membership, doesn't seem to equate to lifetime development. the app has noticably degraded in terms of performance and bugs"
            2. _Alexander Husted_, 10 мар. 2026 г., 1/5: "After using the app for a while, and paying for lifetime membership, I started having bugs which made the app unusable. I wrote to support, but haven't received an answer. I run it in on a Galaxy S21 with Android 15"
            3. _Mateus Garcia_, 26 мар. 2026 г., 5/5: "I had left a negative review previously because the app was very slow to load, but I'm happy to say this is fixed now. I am now using it and it works very well. Habitify is a fantastic app and the wear os app complements it very well."
<!--/ir-theme-->
